speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Presence of immature cells with large, prominent nucleoli and pink, elongated, needle-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia. The peripheral blood smear findings of immature cells (blasts) with prominent nucleoli and needle-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions (Auer rods) are pathognomonic for this condition, ruling out the previously suspected iron deficiency anemia.
